recommendation: Keep the commit as-is; the current core source now matches the FHIR-7127 naming intent while leaving later Procedure.reason datatype changes and Extension Pack ownership intact.
issue_request: FHIR-7127 was Published and resolved Persuasive with Modification. It asked to simplify Procedure by replacing Procedure.indication with reason[x], allowing a coded reason or Condition reference, and moving the complicated Procedure.relatedItem relationship to a caused-by extension while excluding MedicationDispense, CarePlan, and Condition from the old relatedItem space.
initial_application: The historical application appears in git commit dad2eb90486cc27973ed91c84911e089035acee3, whose subject explicitly mentions 7127 and changed Procedure.indication to Procedure.reason[x] in the old Procedure spreadsheet and examples. That application also introduced Procedure notes, but the note still used the stale term indication.
additional_context: Procedure is active in source/fhir.ini, current Procedure source defines Procedure.reason as CodeableReference and no longer defines Procedure.relatedItem, and the caused-by extension is maintained outside core in the FHIR Extension Pack as procedure-causedBy. FHIR-8261 is the related Procedure request/reference issue that FHIR-7127 cited for CarePlan handling.
reconciliation: Changed source/procedure/procedure-notes.xml so the Procedure properties note says implementations may infer reason from Procedure.code rather than the obsolete indication property name. No structural Procedure or extension edit was needed.
source_changes: source/procedure/procedure-notes.xml: Replaced the stale Procedure properties note term "indication" with "reason".
